sections.title: Hi-Gloss Polyethylene
sections.description: AutoPlate’s unique Hi-Gloss Polyethylene License Plates are available in 4 thicknesses with Screen Printed spot color imprint. Plate size is 6" x 12". Our exclusive .075" Premium Weight and .055" Standard Weight Hi-Gloss Poly license plates are for permanent use where a front state license plate is not required. Hi-Gloss .035" and .023" weights are primarily for temporary auto dealer use. Full bleed printing available at no extra charge.

sections.title: Hi-Gloss Aluminum
sections.description: .024" Non-embossed White or Natural Aluminum with Screen Printed spot color imprint. Plate size is 6" x 12". .024" Aluminum License Plates are for permanent use where a front state license plate is not required and a metal plate is preferred.
